title: Northwind Health Claims and Appeals Guide: Claim submission
passage: In-network providers submit claims electronically within 180 days of the date of service. Claims submitted after 180 days are denied for timely filing, and the member may not be billed for them. Out-of-network claims on the PPO plan may be submitted by the provider or the member within 365 days. Clean claims are paid within 30 days of receipt. A claim missing required information is pended, and the provider is notified within 15 days of what is missing.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Claims and Appeals Guide

title: Northwind Health Claims and Appeals Guide: Common denial reasons
passage: No prior authorization on file for a service that requires it. Service not covered under the member's plan. Coverage was not active on the date of service. Duplicate claim. Diagnosis code does not support medical necessity for the billed procedure. Screening service billed with a diagnostic code, which can be corrected and resubmitted.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Claims and Appeals Guide

title: Northwind Health Claims and Appeals Guide: Corrected claims
passage: A claim denied for a coding error is corrected and resubmitted, not appealed. Corrected claims must be submitted within 90 days of the original denial and must reference the original claim number.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Claims and Appeals Guide

title: Northwind Health Claims and Appeals Guide: Appeals
passage: A member or a provider acting for the member may file a first-level appeal within 180 days of the denial. The appeal should include the denial letter, the reason the decision is wrong, and supporting chart notes or letters of medical necessity. Northwind decides standard pre-service appeals within 30 days and post-service appeals within 60 days. Expedited appeals for urgent care are decided within 72 hours. If the first-level appeal is upheld, the member may request a second-level internal review within 60 days, and then an independent external review through the state within 4 months of the final internal decision.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Claims and Appeals Guide

title: Northwind Health Claims and Appeals Guide: Member cost sharing
passage: PPO plan: $30 primary care copay, $60 specialist copay, $1,500 individual deductible, 20% coinsurance in network after the deductible, $5,000 individual out-of-pocket maximum. HMO plan: $20 primary care copay, $45 specialist copay with a referral, no deductible for office visits, $4,000 individual out-of-pocket maximum. Preventive services are covered at no cost share in network on both plans.

title: Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy: Scope
passage: This policy applies to all Northwind Health PPO and HMO members. It describes which preventive services are covered with no cost sharing when performed by an in-network provider. Out-of-network preventive services on the PPO plan are subject to the deductible and 40% coinsurance. The HMO plan does not cover out-of-network preventive services except in an emergency.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy

title: Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy: Covered at no cost share in network
passage: Northwind Health covers, at no copay, coinsurance, or deductible, preventive services that have an A or B rating from the United States Preventive Services Task Force on the first day of the plan year. This includes blood pressure screening, lipid screening, prediabetes and type 2 diabetes screening for adults aged 35 to 70 with overweight or obesity, cervical cancer screening, screening mammography, low-dose CT lung cancer screening for eligible adults, osteoporosis screening, hepatitis C screening, depression screening, and colorectal cancer screening. The annual preventive visit is covered once per plan year at no cost share. Problems addressed during the preventive visit may be billed separately and are subject to the member's office visit copay.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy

title: Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy: Colorectal cancer screening
passage: Average-risk members are covered for colorectal cancer screening starting at age 45. Covered screening tests are a fecal immunochemical test (FIT) every year, a multitarget stool DNA test every 1 to 3 years, CT colonography every 5 years, flexible sigmoidoscopy every 5 years, or colonoscopy every 10 years. Members at increased risk are covered for screening colonoscopy at an earlier age and a shorter interval when the ordering clinician documents the risk factor. A first-degree relative diagnosed with colorectal cancer or an advanced adenoma qualifies the member for screening colonoscopy starting at age 40, or 10 years before the relative's age at diagnosis, whichever is earlier, repeated every 5 years. The order must list the family history diagnosis code.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy

title: Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy: Colorectal cancer screening
passage: A follow-up colonoscopy after a positive stool-based screening test is part of the screening process and is covered at no cost share. Removal of polyps during a screening colonoscopy does not change the visit to diagnostic for cost-sharing purposes. Anesthesia and pathology for a covered screening colonoscopy are covered at no cost share. Screening colonoscopy does not require prior authorization. A colonoscopy ordered for symptoms such as bleeding, anemia, or a change in bowel habits is diagnostic and is subject to the member's specialist copay and deductible.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy

title: Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy: Breast cancer screening
passage: Screening mammography, including digital breast tomosynthesis, is covered every year for members aged 40 to 74 at no cost share. Supplemental breast MRI for members with dense breasts or a lifetime risk above 20% requires prior authorization.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy

title: Northwind Health Preventive Services Policy: Statins for prevention
passage: Generic moderate-intensity statins are covered at no cost share for members aged 40 to 75 who have one or more cardiovascular risk factors and a 10-year cardiovascular risk of 10% or greater. Brand-name statins are covered at the tier 3 copay.

title: Northwind Health Prior Authorization Requirements: How prior authorization works
passage: The ordering provider submits the request through the Northwind provider portal or by fax with the order, the diagnosis codes, and the supporting chart notes. Standard requests are decided within 7 calendar days. Urgent requests, where waiting could seriously harm the member's health, are decided within 72 hours. An approval is valid for 90 days from the decision date unless the letter says otherwise. A service that needs prior authorization and is performed without it is denied. The member is not billed for an in-network service denied only because the provider did not request authorization.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Prior Authorization Requirements

title: Northwind Health Prior Authorization Requirements: Services that require prior authorization
passage: Advanced imaging: MRI, CT, PET, and nuclear cardiology studies in an outpatient setting. CT colonography for screening and low-dose CT for lung cancer screening are exempt. Sleep studies, both in-lab and home sleep apnea testing. Genetic testing, including BRCA1 and BRCA2 testing and hereditary cancer panels. Requests must show the member meets family history criteria. Specialty drugs and biologics, including PCSK9 inhibitors, GLP-1 receptor agonists prescribed for weight management, and biologics for rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, and inflammatory bowel disease. Elective inpatient admissions, inpatient rehabilitation, skilled nursing facility stays, and home health care. Durable medical equipment with a purchase price over $500, including CPAP machines after the first 90 days.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Prior Authorization Requirements

title: Northwind Health Prior Authorization Requirements: Services that do not require prior authorization
passage: Office visits with in-network primary care providers and specialists, routine laboratory tests including lipid panels, hemoglobin A1c, and comprehensive metabolic panels, screening colonoscopy, screening mammography, vaccines, and emergency care.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Prior Authorization Requirements

title: Northwind Health Prior Authorization Requirements: Step therapy
passage: PCSK9 inhibitors are approved only after the member has taken a high-intensity statin, or the maximum tolerated statin dose, together with ezetimibe for at least 3 months and LDL cholesterol remains at or above 70 mg/dL in a member with established cardiovascular disease, or at or above 100 mg/dL otherwise. Documented statin intolerance to two different statins satisfies the statin requirement. GLP-1 receptor agonists for type 2 diabetes are approved after a trial of metformin of at least 3 months, unless metformin is contraindicated or the member has established cardiovascular disease or chronic kidney disease.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Prior Authorization Requirements

title: Northwind Health Prior Authorization Requirements: Peer-to-peer review
passage: If a request is denied for medical necessity, the ordering provider may request a peer-to-peer conversation with a Northwind medical director within 14 days of the denial. A peer-to-peer review does not replace the member's right to appeal.
locator: Northwind Health, Northwind Health Prior Authorization Requirements
